days.title: Meseta to the Basque hills
days.sleep: Bilbao (Saturday: driving into the centre is allowed)
flags: Madrid ZBE: start point depends on registration
Bilbao ZBE is enforced on weekdays only: Saturday arrival is fine

stops.note: Leave 11:30. If the car isn't Madrid-registered, start outside the city limits.
Gothic cathedral right off the A-1. About 1.5h.
Arrive about 18:15, the last 40 minutes after dark on the motorway. Floodlit Guggenheim from outside (last entry 18:30), then pintxos in the Casco Viejo by metro.

days.title: The Basque coast road
days.sleep: Biarritz, or Anglet for easier parking
flags: San Sebastián ZBE: unlabelled cars banned 24/7
AP-8 toll

stops.note: Fishing port on the cliffside N-634 between Zumaia and Zarautz.
La Concha bay and a pintxos lunch. Park outside the ZBE.
Sunset over the Rocher de la Vierge, around 17:20.

days.title: Along the Pyrenees
days.sleep: Carcassonne, new town below the Cité
flags: Stay on the motorway past Toulouse (ZFE)
French tolls

stops.note: A balcony view of the whole Pyrenean chain. About 1h.
Walk up to the floodlit Cité after dark.

days.title: Provence and the red corniche
flags: Stay on the motorway past Montpellier and Marseille (ZFE)
Longest day: leave 07:30

stops.note: Roman aqueduct, 30 minutes off the A9.
Leave the A8 here around 14:30 for the D559.
30 km of red porphyry cliffs over the sea. Rejoin the A8 at Mandelieu.
Last French town before Italy.

days.title: The three Corniches
flags: Do not drive into central Nice (ZFE)

stops.note: Deep harbour and old town.
Perched village; drive back on the Grande Corniche.
Harbour and casino square.

days.title: Liguria to the Leaning Tower
flags: Pisa and Lucca ZTL: park outside the walls
Italian tolls
24 Dec: early closing; book Christmas Eve dinner

stops.note: Afternoon visit, 1.5h. Park outside the walls.
Walk the city walls at dusk.

days.title: Christmas in Chianti
days.sleep: Figline Valdarno, south of Florence (train to Florence)
flags: 25 Dec: museums and most shops closed; book Christmas lunch
The car never enters Florence (Euro 0 diesel ban)

stops.note: Leave after breakfast.
Walled ridge village where the best stretch of the SR222 begins.
Christmas lunch above the vineyards (book ahead).
Triangular piazza, lit up for Christmas.
On the Florence–Arezzo railway; regional trains to Firenze SMN in about 35 minutes.

days.title: Florence on St Stephen's Day
flags: 26 Dec: Uffizi, Accademia, Pitti open 08:15–18:30; Cupola 12:45–17:15; Cathedral closed
Holiday train timetable: check the last train back

stops.note: Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio, the Baptistery and the Cupola climb. The car stays in Figline.

days.title: Arezzo and Bocca Trabaria
flags: Arezzo ZTL: park outside the walls
Italian winter-equipment signs on the pass (15 Nov–15 Apr)
Leave at 08:00 to reach San Marino before dark

stops.note: Piazza Grande on a quiet Sunday morning.
Walled hill town over the upper Tiber valley; quick lunch.
1,049 m pass between Tuscany and the Marche.
Drive through on the way down to San Marino.
Three towers on Monte Titano.

days.title: Po Delta to the Venice lagoon
flags: Mon 28 Dec: old diesels are banned 08:30–18:30 in the towns of the Po plain, Comacchio included: see Rules
Check the SS309 Romea against the ban maps; fallback A14–A13–A4 via Bologna (+1h, heads west first)

stops.note: Lagoon town of canals and bridges, under 30,000 people.
Trains to Venezia Santa Lucia in about 20 minutes. Check it is outside the ban list (about 28,000 people).

days.title: Venice on foot
flags: Car stays parked

stops.note: Train from Mogliano Veneto (about 20 min). Check the acqua alta forecast.

days.title: Roman Friuli and the Karst
flags: Slovenian e-vignette from the border (€16, 7 days)

stops.note: Basilica floor mosaic and Roman ruins.
White castle on the sea at the edge of Trieste.
Lunch on Piazza Unità.
Christmas lights along the Ljubljanica.

days.title: Zagreb Advent
flags: Croatian winter equipment (15 Nov–15 Apr)
Daytime headlights on
31 Dec: book the hotel early; shops close early

stops.note: Afternoon in the Upper Town, Advent market in the evening.

days.title: Across the Pannonian plain
days.sleep: Belgrade, Novi Beograd for easy parking
flags: Serbian border: Green Card and passports
Croatian and Serbian tolls
1 Jan: almost everything closed; a good day to drive

stops.note: Kalemegdan fortress at the meeting of the Sava and Danube.

days.title: The Danube Iron Gates
flags: Romanian rovinietă from the border
Romania is one hour ahead
2 Jan is a public holiday in Serbia and Romania

stops.note: Medieval towers where the gorge begins.
Mesolithic settlement on the riverbank.
Border crossing on top of the dam.

days.title: The last run east
flags: Rovinietă still valid

stops.note: Lunch and fuel.
Arrive early afternoon.
